tasks.short: Direct research by teachers and advanced-degree students.

steps.what: Retrieve current research drafts, experiment versions and prior supervision notes through native project links
inputs: actual researcher drafts and experiment records
existing prior supervision notes

steps.what: Read the research and assess methods, evidence, progress and intellectual contribution
inputs: checked research supervision source set
outputs: supervisors assessment and proposed research directions

steps.what: Discuss the research with teachers or graduate students and direct the next investigation
inputs: supervisors assessment and proposed research directions
actual researcher questions and explanations
outputs: actual research discussion and agreed directions

steps.what: Write and approve actual research decisions, unresolved questions and next experiments
inputs: actual research discussion and agreed directions

steps.what: Save the approved final research supervision note
inputs: approved final research supervision note

tasks.design: Configure current draft and experiment links in {RESEARCH_PROJECT_SYSTEM}. OTHER is the existing research code/experiment repository. Keep reading, research assessment and supervision conversations fully human. Actual notes follow the discussion; same-system save is separated and earns no saving.
tasks.previous_blocker: Current drafts and experiment versions may require repeated navigation before supervision.
tasks.enabler_now: Native project links can retrieve existing research artefacts together.
tasks.still_hard: Judging novelty and soundness and helping researchers choose the next question.
tasks.human_edge: The supervisor develops a researchers scientific judgement.
tasks.altitude: Human research direction with linked current artefacts.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native project links can connect current research drafts, experiment versions and supervision notes.

assumptions: Shares are provisional; confirm residual source navigation after current project tools. Reading and judgement are not removed.

Researchers already supply their normal draft_version, experiment_id and repository_revision; no extra capture is assumed. s1 checks correspondence and freshness. Missing or conflicting versions require manual clarification.
s4 captures actual decision, unresolved_question, next_experiment and owner after the discussion at full time. Same-system save remains full.
research_questions: Which current research artefacts are still repeatedly located manually before supervision?

approvals.approved_version: s4 actual final research supervision note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only retrieval changes: 10 times 30% = 3 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research work.

steps.what: Check current student work, placement requirements and prior actions in a native supervision view
inputs: actual student work and placement reports
existing agreed supervision requirements

steps.what: Observe and assess the students actual teaching, internship or research work
inputs: teacher-checked supervision evidence set
actual student work and explanations

steps.what: Discuss actual progress and agree feedback and next work with the student
inputs: teacher observations and supervision judgement
actual student concerns
outputs: actual feedback discussion and agreed next work

steps.what: Write and approve actual supervision evidence, feedback and next actions
inputs: actual feedback discussion and agreed next work
teacher observations and supervision judgement

steps.what: Save the approved final student supervision record
inputs: approved final student supervision record

tasks.design: Configure native {LMS} supervision views to bring existing student work, placement reports and agreed actions together. Keep actual observation, judgement and feedback conversations human. Capture actual outcomes afterwards and retain the separate same-system save without claiming a save benefit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Supervision sources may be scattered across student and placement records.
tasks.enabler_now: Native student views can group existing evidence and prior actions.
tasks.still_hard: Assessing authentic work and coaching the student in context.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher interprets performance and supports professional growth.
tasks.altitude: Human student supervision with current evidence retrieval.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native LMS views may group existing student artefacts and supervision requirements.

assumptions: Provisional allocation covers one supervised work instance; actual teaching/internship/research mixes must be observed. Existing views earn no new saving.

Students and placement supervisors produce normal existing submissions and placement reports with student_id, work_id, reporting_date and source_author; no new uncounted reporting is assumed. s1 checks sources. Missing evidence requires manual follow-up.
s4 captures actual evidence, feedback and agreed_next_action at full time after supervision. Same-system save and all live assessment stay fully retained.
research_questions: What source-finding effort remains after current LMS supervision views?

incremental.description: Maintain supervision source links and access mappings

approvals.approved_version: s4 final actual student supervision record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only retrieval changes: 10 times 30% = 3 hours less 0.5 upkeep = 2.5. Low halves retrieval benefit: 1.5 minus 0.5 = 1.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Conduct computer science research and publish findings.

steps.what: Formulate the research, design methods and conduct actual experiments or theoretical investigation
inputs: actual research question and source literature
actual research code, data or mathematical arguments
outputs: actual research evidence, methods and investigator notes

steps.what: Verify actual result records, dataset versions, units and reproducible analysis parameters
inputs: actual research evidence, methods and investigator notes
outputs: researcher-checked result dataset and analysis specification

steps.what: Generate and check exact result tables and figures using the native analysis notebook
inputs: researcher-checked result dataset and analysis specification

steps.what: Interpret findings and write the paper with methods, limitations and verified source references
inputs: researcher-checked publication tables and figures
actual research evidence, methods and investigator notes
actual source literature

steps.what: Check and approve the complete final manuscript, author permissions and journal submission destination
inputs: complete research manuscript draft
actual author permissions and journal requirements
outputs: approved final manuscript and submission destination

steps.what: Submit the approved final manuscript to the selected journal
inputs: approved final manuscript and submission destination

steps.what: Read actual editorial responses and revise the manuscript and proofs where required
inputs: actual submitted manuscript version
actual editorial decisions, reviewer comments and proofs
outputs: actual corrected publication proof or revised manuscript

steps.what: Approve the actual complete corrected publication version and destination after editorial changes
inputs: actual corrected publication proof or revised manuscript
actual editorial requirements and author permissions
outputs: approved final corrected publication version and destination

steps.what: Send the approved final corrected version or publication release to the editor
inputs: approved final corrected publication version and destination
outputs: actual final author submission or release

tasks.design: Configure reusable exact table and figure generation in {ANALYSIS_NOTEBOOK}, denoted OTHER alongside the existing research code environment. Keep research, source verification, interpretation and manuscript writing human. Each initial submission and later corrected publication release has its own final-version gate after that version exists. No publication acceptance is presumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual result values may be manually reformatted into repeated publication tables and plots.
tasks.enabler_now: Native analysis notebooks can reproduce exact figures from checked datasets and parameters.
tasks.still_hard: Scientific novelty, experimental validity and interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The researcher decides what the evidence means and takes responsibility for claims.
tasks.altitude: Human research and publication with reproducible result presentation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native analysis notebooks can generate repeatable tables and plots from checked datasets.

assumptions: All shares are provisional for one publication cycle, including retained revisions. Actual revision burden varies. Existing notebook generation, experiment runtime and publisher labour earn no new saving.

Researcher produces actual run_id, method_version, parameter_values, observed_result and units in s1 and validates them in s2 at full time. s3 retains 6 hours for mapping, visual inspection and checks; no unavailable result or study baseline is invented. Without repeatable actual data, table preparation stays manual.

The full s4 writing and interpretation are retained. Editorial responses are real inputs to s7, not assumed acceptance. Each later version repeats s7-s9 with final approval; actual author permissions are checked before each external send. No same-system save saving is banked.
research_questions: Which tables or plots are still manually re-created after existing analysis notebooks?

incremental.description: Maintain reproducible result-to-figure mappings and audit output labels

approvals.approved_version: s5 actual complete final manuscript and journal destination
s8 actual complete corrected publication version and destination

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only residual result presentation changes: 15 times 60% = 9 hours minus 1 upkeep = 8. Low halves this benefit: 4.5 minus 1 = 3.5.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Review the current laboratory exercise, expected behaviour and student setup
inputs: actual laboratory exercise and existing instructions
actual student environment and questions

steps.what: Observe students laboratory work, diagnose difficulties and coach their understanding
inputs: teacher-checked laboratory context
actual student code, actions and explanations
outputs: actual laboratory supervision and learning observations

steps.what: Write and approve actual laboratory progress, difficulties and agreed follow-up
inputs: actual laboratory supervision and learning observations
outputs: approved final actual laboratory supervision note

steps.what: Save the approved final laboratory supervision note
inputs: approved final actual laboratory supervision note

tasks.design: Retain live laboratory supervision. OTHER denotes the existing {STUDENT_CODE_ENVIRONMENT}. Review of exercise/setup and later actual note writing/save are separated from interaction. Assessing native exercise links, test output views and note templates finds no additional change under the stated already-configured laboratory setup.
tasks.previous_blocker: The teacher must distinguish a working program from a student understanding why it works.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing laboratory tools expose instructions and test output already; no further benefit is established.
tasks.still_hard: Diagnosing misconceptions through actual student work and explanation.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher coaches rather than merely supplies a working answer.
tasks.altitude: Human laboratory teaching with explicit preparation and note boundaries.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: existing laboratory code tools can show tests and instructions, but these do not establish student understanding.

assumptions: All shares are provisional. Before assigning zero, exercise lookup and actual progress-note writing/save were split out and native views/templates considered. This instance assumes instructions, code/test output and the direct note template are already available together; no residual duplicate entry is established.

s3 captures actual student_id, exercise_id, observed_difficulty and agreed_follow_up at full time after supervision. No progress is inferred from planned attendance. Same-system save remains full; no new tool means no incremental upkeep.
unknowns: Whether laboratory notes are re-keyed elsewhere
research_questions: Is there residual lookup or duplicate progress entry beyond the existing configured lab tools?

incremental.description: No new tool or maintenance; current lab supervision retained

approvals.approved_version: s3 actual final laboratory supervision note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Preparation, live coaching, separated actual note writing and same-system save remain fully retained; existing native functions earn no new saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Human research and student supervision with current evidence and reproducible results.
reach: Less repeated research-source navigation and result formatting
skills_to_grow: Checking source versions and actual supervision records
role.ambitious_version: Teachers retain scientific and educational judgement while using native tools for residual source retrieval and exact result presentation.
